notes: Wife of Presley Adams; her birth surname is not recorded.
Frances Adams, aged 24 in the 1940 census (born about 1916), at Richmond, California; named as Presley's wife on his 1940 draft card and in his 1987 obituary.
Born Frances Korecki on 9 Mar 1916 at Toledo, Ohio; Woodward High School, Toledo, 1932; died 7 Dec 2002 at Richmond, California (Turner / Harvey Family Tree).
